assertion.statement: Each specified actual automorphism of the finite Galois compositum is realized by arithmetic Frobenius at a suitable chosen place over infinitely many rational primes, avoiding the finite exclusions.

assertion.hypotheses: The extension is finite Galois over Q, the prescribed automorphism exists in its Galois group, and only finitely many primes are excluded.
assertion.quantifiers: For each such finite extension and actual automorphism, infinitely many unramified rational primes and a place over each realizing that representative.
assertion.parameter_range: Finite Galois extensions only; each precision is treated separately.
assertion.uniformity: No effective size bound, infinite-level density or uniformity over extension degree is asserted.
assertion.constants: The nonempty conjugacy class has positive density equal to its size divided by the finite Galois group order.
assertion.normalizations: Arithmetic Frobenius acts by the residue-field norm power. A rational prime determines a conjugacy class; conjugating the place selects the actual representative.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Compatibility on intersections is an input from an actual automorphism, not a consequence of Chebotarev. The theorem does not independently prescribe arbitrary component actions.
assertion.limit_order: Form the finite normal compositum and actual compatible element; apply finite Chebotarev and choose a place; only later pass to the retained precision limit or apply localized model maps.

output_assertion.hypotheses: The extension is finite Galois over Q, the prescribed automorphism exists in its Galois group, and only finitely many primes are excluded.
output_assertion.quantifiers: For each such finite extension and actual automorphism, infinitely many unramified rational primes and a place over each realizing that representative.
output_assertion.parameter_range: Finite Galois extensions only; each precision is treated separately.
output_assertion.uniformity: No effective size bound, infinite-level density or uniformity over extension degree is asserted.
output_assertion.constants: The nonempty conjugacy class has positive density equal to its size divided by the finite Galois group order.
output_assertion.normalizations: Arithmetic Frobenius acts by the residue-field norm power. A rational prime determines a conjugacy class; conjugating the place selects the actual representative.
output_assertion.exceptional_cases: Compatibility on intersections is an input from an actual automorphism, not a consequence of Chebotarev. The theorem does not independently prescribe arbitrary component actions.
output_assertion.limit_order: Form the finite normal compositum and actual compatible element; apply finite Chebotarev and choose a place; only later pass to the retained precision limit or apply localized model maps.

assertion.statement: For the actual imaginary quadratic K, O_(K,S_T)* modulo squares has F2 dimension1+|S_T|.
assertion.objects: The actual imaginary quadratic field and its finite S_T-unit group.
assertion.hypotheses: K is imaginary quadratic; its ordinary class group is finite; S_T is finite.
assertion.quantifiers: Each permitted K and S_T in the residual estimate.
assertion.parameter_range: Residual scalar coefficients F2, before doubling to W=F2^2.
assertion.uniformity: Exact sequence for the same actual support.
assertion.normalizations: The rank is |S_T| and the finite cyclic roots of unity contribute one squareclass.
assertion.exceptional_cases: This does not bound the two-rank of the S-class group; that is the subsequent local genus argument.
assertion.limit_order: Use ordinary unit rank zero and class-group finiteness. The valuation image of S-units is finite index in Z^(S_T), since each prime ideal has a principal power; then reduce the resulting finitely generated group modulo squares.

use.reason: Uses ordinary units and finite class group to derive the S-unit rank at the exact support.

supplier.statement: Minkowski bounds an integral representative of each ideal class by (n!/n^n)(4/pi)^r2 sqrt(|disc K|); the unit group has rank r1+r2-1 with torsion the roots of unity.

assertion.statement: For a split conductor prime r, the actual ring-class group has kernel F_r* over Cl(K), represented by the ratio of residue factors; the chosen class lifts and all principal relation-basis relations give its complete presentation.
assertion.objects: The order Z+rO_K, its invertible ideal-class group, and the actual generating prime ideals p_j.
assertion.hypotheses: K is imaginary quadratic with units exactly plus or minus one; r splits in K and avoids the chosen primes. The p_j generate Cl(K); their integral relation lattice and principal beta_a are fixed.
assertion.quantifiers: Each permitted split prime r and the actual finite generating family.
assertion.parameter_range: Invertible locally principal order ideals; conductor r.
assertion.uniformity: No splitting of the extension of groups or division by |Cl(K)| is required.
assertion.normalizations: Ratio of the two residue factors modulo diagonal rational residues; delta is oriented to give the displayed principal relations.
assertion.exceptional_cases: This is the split-r kernel, not the inert-prime ell+1 kernel. Noninvertible ideals are excluded.
assertion.limit_order: Form the idelic quotient, compute the order-unit kernel, lift class generators, then verify all relations by projecting to their relation lattice.

use.reason: Supplies the idelic ring-class quotient before the local residue-kernel and relation-presentation computation.
